name: Hyperbolic Crystal Symbiosis
description: Voronoi crystal facets on a true Poincaré disk with geodesic distance and Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion. Kaleidoscope symmetry mirrors the domain into audio-reactive sectors, while an audio-driven palette shifts crystal hues with bass, mids and treble. Iridescent thin-film coloring on facet edges with HDR bloom at triple junctions. Bass drives crystal growth, mids morph curvature, treble adds sparkle. Mouse warps the disk center; click ripples propagate through the crystal, and organic drift warps the domain. smin blends Euclidean and hyperbolic metrics for smooth geometric transitions. Chromatic aberration and temporal luma feedback add a living, layered glow.

params.name: Base Curvature
params.description: Strength of the hyperbolic distortion and smin blend between Euclidean and hyperbolic metrics

params.name: Species Tension
params.description: How strongly the two crystal types compete; also controls kaleidoscope sector count

params.name: Mouse Curvature Power
params.description: How strongly the mouse warps local geometry and temporal feedback
